verdict.rationale: Circle exposes event-driven building blocks — webhooks that POST on resource state changes (circle-docs-10), CCTP's ability to trigger automated actions once assets arrive on a destination chain (circle-docs-5), and Agent Wallets with configurable spending policies (circle-docs-6, circle-docs-19) — which together let developers react to events and enforce policy-based rules. However there is no documented no-code/if-this-then-that rules engine; users must write their own logic to consume webhooks and define policies programmatically. Missing for 10: a dedicated rules/automation engine UI or declarative rule definitions, and independent evidence of this automation depth being used in practice.
